_doc: Know your enemy (winning-build plan 2026-11-13, section 3.1; src/enemy_lore.py). 'recall': what Recall Lore says of the creature in view, by chain (1 its family; 2 one weakness; 3 its resistances; 4 what it shrugs off and what its nature refuses; 5 all of it, and its Bestiary page opens with no family credit); each chain says what the ones below it say. {The}/{the} is the creature, {kin} its family ('the restless dead'), {word_cap} one weakness, {words} a list, {effects} a list of what it cannot be made ('put to sleep, poisoned or charmed', from data/tells.json status_words). 'probe': what the Wand of Probing reads: everything (it is a deliberate tool), and it opens the page too. 'quest_teach': a gate boss cannot be studied before the fight, so the key step of his quest opens his page, and the quest-giver names his weakness in her or his own voice; every line must stay true to the boss's lists in data/monsters.json: 'claims' names what the line says, and tests/test_know_your_enemy.py checks each claim against monsters.json.

recall.no_family: {The} is like nothing in the old stories.
recall.no_weak: You can recall nothing that hurts {him} more than any other blow.
recall.nothing_more: {He} shrugs off nothing, and nothing in {his} nature refuses a spell.
recall.whole: It all comes back: you know {the} whole now. {His} page is open in your Bestiary.
recall.unstudied: You have not studied enough of {his} kind to remember more. Corpses of {his} family would teach you.

probe.nothing: Nothing about {him} is weak or hard: every blow lands plain.
probe.page: The page for {the} is open in your Bestiary now.

lines: Ariadne's voice comes again, softer: "Not the club, nor the hammer. He was born of a bull: a point between the ribs."
asterion_minotaur.page: You know Asterion now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: Athena speaks once more: "Perseus took her head with one stroke of a curved sword: an edge is what ends her. Her blood is venom, so poison will not."
medusa_gorgon.page: You know Medusa now: her page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: The old voice again: "Dig where he crawls down to drink, as Sigurd did, and strike up with a point. His scales turn edge and hammer, fire and venom. And a worm lying on his gold is quick to fall asleep."
fafnir_dragon.page: You know Fafnir now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: A gruff voice from the dark behind the anvil: "Bound is not beaten. He was whelped in the cold, and an edge slides off that coat. But he is a wolf, and fire bites every wolf."
fenrir_wolf.page: You know Fenrir now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: The voice that weighed you speaks once more: "Fire, frost and venom are his own, and steel that cuts or crushes slides off him. What is holy wounds the Destroyer most."
abaddon_destroyer.page: You know Abaddon now: his page is open in your Bestiary.
